name: Mofisu Clan Informant
desc:
Mofisu Clan Informant is an Etrean NPC.

[The Inheritor](entity:the_inheritor) is able to speak to them once they defeat the [Shogun of the Prophet's Guard](entity:shogun_of_the_prophets_guard_temple_of_mur) in the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur). They send messages for Clan Mofisu and speaks of the [Rat King](entity:dravik_the_rat_king), who can penetrate [The Lord Regents](entity:the_lord_regent) barriers.
